events.title: China proposes AI export restrictions and starts temporary registration
events.title_zh: 中国拟调整 AI 技术出口目录，并启动临时登记
organization: Ministry of Science and Technology of China
events.summary_en: China opened consultation on adding 40 technologies to its prohibited and restricted export catalogue, including 23 AI technologies spanning large models, agents, compute clusters and information processing. The catalogue changes are a draft, not final restrictions. A temporary pre-export registration requirement took effect on publication and applies until the revision is finalized.
events.summary_zh: 中国就技术出口目录新增 40 项技术征求意见，其中 23 项涉及大模型、agent、算力集群与信息处理。目录调整仍是草案，不是已经生效的最终限制。与此同时，出口前临时登记已从公告发布时生效，并持续到目录修订正式实施。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams transferring AI technology, licensing it abroad or planning overseas deployment, the live registration duty changes compliance work now, while final restricted scope remains unsettled. Public open-source releases and API/SaaS delivery have important stated boundaries.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对向境外转让、许可 AI 技术或规划海外部署的团队来说，已经生效的登记义务会立刻改变合规流程，但最终限制范围仍未确定。公开开源与 API/SaaS 交付有重要边界，不能把草案写成全面禁令。

technical_details.policy_stage: catalogue amendment is open for comment through 2026-11-15
technical_details.effective_measure: temporary pre-export registration effective 2026-10-16 16:00 China time
technical_details.stated_boundaries: public-domain open source and publications proposed excluded; API, SaaS, app and lightweight edge delivery are not by themselves technology export

technical_details_zh.已生效措施: 出口前临时登记自北京时间2026-10-16 16:00生效
technical_details_zh.官方边界: 公开领域的开源/论文拟排除；API、SaaS、App和轻量端侧交付本身不等于技术出口

events.title: NVIDIA releases Dory1.0-4B with selectable recurrent depth
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布可调循环深度的 Dory1.0-4B
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布 4B 参数的 Dory1.0-4B 开放权重，同一 checkpoint 可运行一、二或四次共享循环层，以额外计算换取任务准确率。BF16、MXFP8、NVFP4 与 Q5_K_M GGUF 已可下载，支持 256K 上下文。上游 vLLM 支持仍在 PR 中，llama.cpp 需要固定的 NVIDIA fork。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released open weights for the 4B-parameter Dory1.0-4B. One checkpoint can run its shared recurrent block one, two or four times, trading more compute for task accuracy. BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4 and Q5_K_M GGUF variants are downloadable with 256K context. Upstream vLLM support remains a pull request, and llama.cpp requires a pinned NVIDIA fork.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地模型团队来说，可调循环深度允许同一权重覆盖延迟与准确率档位，可能减少模型切换；但运行时未进入稳定上游，厂商 benchmark 不能替代端到端复测。
events.why_it_matters_en: For local-model teams, selectable recurrent depth lets one checkpoint cover latency and accuracy tiers, potentially reducing model swaps. Runtime support is not yet in stable upstream releases, and vendor benchmarks do not replace end-to-end tests.

technical_details.architecture: 8 input layers + shared 20-layer recurrent block + 8 output layers
technical_details.runtime_boundary: vLLM support under review; llama.cpp uses pinned NVIDIA fork

technical_details_zh.架构: 8 层输入 + 共享 20 层循环块 + 8 层输出
technical_details_zh.循环次数: 同一 checkpoint 可选 1、2 或 4 次
technical_details_zh.运行时边界: vLLM 支持仍在评审；llama.cpp 需固定 NVIDIA fork

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开 GGUF 或参考路径跑同一组任务，比较 1/2/4 次循环的成功率、延迟、输出 token 与峰值内存。
events.next_action_en: In one day, use the public GGUF or reference path on one task set and compare 1/2/4 loops for success, latency, output tokens and peak memory.

evidence.claim_zh: Dory1.0-4B 多种权重已公开，可从同一 checkpoint 选择循环深度。
evidence.claim_en: Dory1.0-4B weights are public and expose selectable recurrent depth from one checkpoint.

events.title: NVIDIA launches RTX Spark PCs for local AI development
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 推出面向本地 AI 开发的 RTX Spark PC
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 推出基于 Arm Grace CPU 与 Blackwell RTX GPU 的 RTX Spark 笔记本和小型桌面机。高配型号宣称提供 128GB 统一内存，可在 Windows 11/WSL 上运行本地模型、CUDA 与 agent 工具。官方页面已链接多家 OEM 商店，但库存、地区和价格并不统一。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA launched RTX Spark laptops and compact desktops built around an Arm Grace CPU and Blackwell RTX GPU. Top configurations advertise 128 GB of unified memory for local models, CUDA and agent tools on Windows 11/WSL. Official pages link several OEM stores, but stock, region and pricing are not uniform.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做本地 AI 与 coding agent 的团队来说，这把大内存 CUDA 开发机带入 Windows PC 形态；采购判断应看具体 SKU、真实库存、软件兼容和端到端吞吐，而不是平台级峰值。
events.why_it_matters_en: For local AI and coding-agent teams, this brings large-memory CUDA development into a Windows PC form factor. Buying decisions should use exact SKU, live stock, software compatibility and end-to-end throughput rather than platform peak claims.

technical_details.top_configuration: up to 128 GB unified memory and vendor-claimed 1 PFLOP FP4
technical_details.software: Windows 11, WSL, CUDA and partner local-agent integrations
technical_details.availability: live OEM shop links coexist with availability alerts; varies by SKU and region
technical_details.evidence_limit: performance comparisons are NVIDIA and partner measurements

events.title: GitHub makes license compliance merge controls generally available
events.title_zh: GitHub 的许可证合并管控正式 GA
events.summary_zh: GitHub 面向已启用 GitHub Code Security 的 Enterprise Cloud 客户开放许可证合规 GA。团队可在 ruleset 中按允许或禁止的许可证阻止合并，并通过企业级 License Manager 角色、审计日志与 API 管理策略。官方页面只有日期，没有可核验的发布时间。
events.summary_en: GitHub made license compliance generally available to Enterprise Cloud customers with GitHub Code Security. Teams can block merges through rulesets based on allowed or denied licenses and manage policy through an enterprise License Manager role, audit logs and APIs. The official page exposes a date but no verifiable publication time.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对维护依赖和 AI 生成代码的企业团队来说，许可证检查从报告变成了可阻断合并的策略；但它受套餐限制，误判与例外流程仍需在真实仓库验证。
events.why_it_matters_en: For enterprise teams managing dependencies and AI-generated code, license checking becomes an enforceable merge policy rather than a report. It is plan-gated, and false positives and exception workflows still need repository-level testing.

technical_details.controls: ruleset condition can block merges by license policy
